text:
Maya: Heads-up: canary to private VPC 'acme-prod' is stuck in 'awaiting-controlplane' for ~45m. console shows 0->10% but no traffic. Anyone seen this?
Sahil: Looking. Can you paste the rollout id? Also which env — air-gapped or VPC peering?
Maya: rollout-2026-03-10-83, acme-prod VPC (on-prem relay), air-gapped. We pushed via private-controlplane API.
deploy-bot: Canary started: rollout=rollout-2026-03-10-83 target=acme-prod canary=10% state=awaiting-controlplane
Judy: We saw a similar issue last month; control plane wasn't able to validate routing policy because the VPC had stale model catalog. The agent only accepts exact model id.
Peter: Confirmed. Agent logs show `config-reject: model_variant not found`. Relay was on 172.20.1.45 and last sync was 2026-03-10T09:12Z.
Maya: Oh — the model id changed after we created the canary. Shouldn't the control plane fallback to name+hash? This breaks canaries in private clusters.
Sahil: Policy: we require model variant exact id for safety. But we could add a 'grace' mode that allows name-based mapping if the agent reports a single matching candidate.
Judy: Grace mode could be dangerous. For air-gapped, I'd prefer a preflight check that surfaces mismatches in the console and blocks start with a clear error + suggested fix.
Maya: UX ask: show propagation ETA per-VPC and a 'force-wait' toggle. Right now users click deploy and wait blind.
Peter: Agreed. For rolling safety, we should also add a 'rollback_window' that auto-reverts if canary stays in awaiting > X.
opsbot: Suggestion added to backlog: PROJ-429 add per-vpc propagation ETA and rollback_window for private rollouts :white_check_mark: 
Sahil: Proposed config snippet:
```yaml
rollout:
  id: rollout-2026-03-10-83
  canary:
    target: acme-prod
    split: 10
    guard: 5m
    rollback_window: 15m
  propagation:
    max_wait: 20m
    grace_mode: false
```
Judy: Also we need telemetry metric `vpc_config_propagation_seconds` + a histogram for failures. Without that we can't alert.
Maya: For immediate unblock, can we patch the agent to accept name->id mapping when `--allow-variant-lookup` is set, then re-run sync?
Sahil: Yes, but require signed audit log and explicit flag per VPC. I'll make a hotfix branch and coordinate with infra to schedule a quick patch.
Maya: Thanks. If we hit a user impact, we should offer rollback to previous stable and escalate to CS.
Peter: I'll add runbook steps: check agent logs `rk-agent sync status`, `rkctl rollout abort <id>`, and patch flag path.
Maya: Cool. Keep me posted. I'll file a short note in the customer thread.
